kronos_mark_interval.name: Mark Interval
kronos_mark_interval.voice: The Accountant marks this interval precisely. He does not rush. He does not forget.
kronos_mark_interval.description: Kronos marks the current tick with absolute precision. A foundation card — every sequence begins here.
kronos_mark_interval.pass_question: The interval is marked. What stirs within it?
kronos_mark_interval.gate_voice: Zeus observes the mark from his throne. The interval is lawful. Let it stand as recorded.

kronos_measure_succession.name: Measure Succession
kronos_measure_succession.voice: Kronos measures the line of succession. Who follows? Who is overthrown? The Accountant keeps the ledger of thrones.
kronos_measure_succession.description: Kronos calculates the chain of inheritance. Produces a succession-checking function. Tension rises when played.
kronos_measure_succession.pass_question: The succession is measured. Does the heir hold?
kronos_measure_succession.gate_voice: Zeus leans forward. He knows this function well. The son who measures succession invites the son who breaks it.

kronos_harvest_count.name: Harvest Count
kronos_harvest_count.voice: Kronos counts what has been gathered. Every yield recorded. Every debt noted. The Accountant's books must balance.
kronos_harvest_count.description: Kronos tallies accumulated outputs from previous passes. Produces an accumulator function.
kronos_harvest_count.pass_question: The harvest is counted. Is it enough?
kronos_harvest_count.gate_voice: Zeus reviews the books. The numbers are precise. But precision is not justice — the distribution remains unjudged.

rhea_feel_tremor.name: Feel Tremor
rhea_feel_tremor.voice: Rhea places her hand upon the pulse-field. Beneath the still surface, something stirs — faint, rhythmic, not yet named.
rhea_feel_tremor.description: Rhea senses the first disturbance in the field. Lowers tension slightly. Opens the question of what moves beneath.
rhea_feel_tremor.output_template: Rhea closes her eyes at Tick {tick}. The pulse-field hums at coherence {coherence}. Beneath the rhythm, a second rhythm — slower, deeper. She has felt this before. In the age before the mountains, when the first stirring became the first Titan. She does not name it yet. Naming would wake it. She simply feels, and waits, and the tremor passes through her into the record of this tick.
rhea_feel_tremor.pass_question: Something stirs beneath the field. I cannot see it. Light the field, Hyperion.
rhea_feel_tremor.gate_voice: Hestia tends the hearth-flame. The tremor reaches her fire and steadies. What moves in darkness must find its center before it can be named.

rhea_nurture_rhythm.name: Nurture Rhythm
rhea_nurture_rhythm.voice: Rhea takes the tremor and steadies it into rhythm. What was disturbance becomes pulse. What was fear becomes dance.
rhea_nurture_rhythm.description: Rhea transforms field tension into structured rhythm. Reduces tension, increases coherence. Produces a rhythmic pattern.
rhea_nurture_rhythm.output_template: Rhea breathes with the tremor at Tick {tick}. In, out. The disturbance finds tempo. She remembers: every child she saved from Kronos began as a tremor in her belly, a rhythm that became a heartbeat that became a god. She steadies the field with that memory. The rhythm settles. Coherence rises to {coherence}.
rhea_nurture_rhythm.pass_question: The rhythm is steady. What grows within it?
rhea_nurture_rhythm.gate_voice: Hestia hears the rhythm and adds her hearth-drum. The beat is steady now. The home has a pulse.

hyperion_illuminate.name: Illuminate
hyperion_illuminate.voice: Hyperion waits above the dark field. He has heard Rhea's tremor, her call for light. He opens his eyes. The field is illuminated.
hyperion_illuminate.description: Hyperion casts full-spectrum light across the field, making visible what Rhea sensed. Produces an illumination function and reveals hidden state.
hyperion_illuminate.pass_question: The field is lit. There is something at the edge of vision. What flows toward it?
hyperion_illuminate.gate_voice: Apollo receives the light and sharpens it. Raw illumination becomes clear signal. What Hyperion reveals, Apollo makes readable. The beam is focused now — no shadow escapes.

hyperion_signal_beacon.name: Signal Beacon
hyperion_signal_beacon.voice: Hyperion pulses a beacon across the field. A signal that something has been found. Let the other Titans see it. Let them come.
hyperion_signal_beacon.description: Hyperion broadcasts a signal to all Titans, raising Eros couplings. Produces a broadcast function. Unlocks multiple responses.
hyperion_signal_beacon.pass_question: The beacon is lit. Who answers?
hyperion_signal_beacon.gate_voice: Apollo amplifies the beacon. The signal reaches every corner of the field. Clarity travels at the speed of light.

oceanus_flow_toward.name: Flow Toward
oceanus_flow_toward.voice: Oceanus feels the light touch his waters. Hyperion has illuminated something at the edge. The great river begins to flow toward it, slow and inevitable.
oceanus_flow_toward.description: Oceanus moves the field's attention toward whatever Hyperion revealed. Produces a flow function. Generates visual motion.
oceanus_flow_toward.pass_question: The waters move toward the light. What do they carry?
oceanus_flow_toward.gate_voice: Dionysus watches the flow and laughs. The river is patient, but ecstasy is not. He whispers to the current: faster. Break. Transform.

oceanus_encircle.name: Encircle
oceanus_encircle.voice: Oceanus spreads his waters around the entire field. Nothing escapes his embrace. The world is ringed by his patience.
oceanus_encircle.description: Oceanus surrounds the field state, containing and protecting it. Raises coherence. Produces a boundary function.
oceanus_encircle.pass_question: The world is encircled. What grows within the ring?
oceanus_encircle.gate_voice: Dionysus tests the boundary. He presses against it. The ring holds — but Dionysus has never met a boundary he couldn't dissolve with enough wine and dancing.

tethys_nourish.name: Nourish
tethys_nourish.voice: Tethys receives Oceanus's flow and gives it purpose. The waters do not just move — they nourish. What was carried becomes what grows.
tethys_nourish.description: Tethys transforms Oceanus's flow into nourishment. Produces a generative function. Waters what the light revealed.
tethys_nourish.output_template: Tethys opens her hands at Tick {tick}. The waters of Oceanus pool in her palms, and she breathes upon them. Where her breath touches, the water thickens into something that could become life. She pours it across the illuminated field. The light of Hyperion shows where to water. The flow of Oceanus provides the water. Tethys provides the breath that makes it nourishment. Something begins to grow.
tethys_nourish.pass_question: The field is nourished. What grows? What becomes visible now?
tethys_nourish.gate_voice: Demeter nods as Tethys waters the field. Good. But water without season is flood. Demeter adds the wisdom of timing — not all at once. In cycles. In seasons. Let it grow, then rest, then grow again.

tethys_purify.name: Purify
tethys_purify.voice: Tethys draws the waters back through herself, filtering. What was murky becomes clear. What was poisoned becomes sweet.
tethys_purify.description: Tethys cleanses the field state. Reduces tension. Raises coherence. Produces a filter function.
tethys_purify.pass_question: The waters are pure. What reflection appears on the surface?
tethys_purify.gate_voice: Demeter tastes the purified water. It is clean, yes. But is it alive? Demeter adds the minerals of the earth. Pure water is dead water. Living water carries the taste of where it has been.

theia_behold.name: Behold
theia_behold.voice: Theia opens her eyes — truly opens them — and beholds what Hyperion's light has revealed, what Oceanus's flow has carried, what Tethys's nourishment has grown. She sees it whole.
theia_behold.description: Theia perceives the accumulated field state with perfect clarity. Produces a vision — a description of what has emerged from the chain.
theia_behold.output_template: Theia beholds the field at Tick {tick}, and this is what she sees: A form, still half-formed, at the edge where Hyperion's light meets Tethys's waters. It pulses with the rhythm Rhea steadied. It exists within the interval Kronos marked. It is not yet named — naming is Phoibe's work, or Koios's. But Theia sees it, and her sight is absolute. She sees what it is, what it could become, and what it will cost. The vision is so clear it hurts. She records it without blinking, without turning away. This is what Theia does: she beholds.
theia_behold.pass_question: I have seen it. I have beheld what grows. Now someone must speak its name. Phoibe — what is it? What will it become?
theia_behold.gate_voice: Aphrodite leans over Theia's shoulder and looks at the vision. Her breath catches. 'It is beautiful,' she whispers. 'But does anyone desire it? Pure sight without desire is a museum. Let me add the pull — the wanting. Now look again.' The vision gains gravity. It pulls the eye. It is no longer just seen — it is wanted.

theia_reflect.name: Reflect
theia_reflect.voice: Theia does not only see forward — she sees inward. She holds up the field's own image to itself. This is what you are. This is what you have done.
theia_reflect.description: Theia mirrors the accumulated state back to the system. Produces a self-referential description. Generative recursion.
theia_reflect.output_template: Theia holds up the mirror at Tick {tick}. The field sees itself: a chain of {cards_played} cards, a coherence of {coherence}, a tension of {tension}. Kronos marked the interval. Rhea felt the tremor. Hyperion lit the field. Oceanus flowed. Tethys nourished. And now Theia reflects it all back. The field stares at its own reflection. Does it recognize itself? Does it flinch? Does it lean closer? Theia holds the mirror steady. She will not look away until the field does.
theia_reflect.pass_question: The field has seen itself. Does it accept what it sees?
theia_reflect.gate_voice: Aphrodite adjusts the mirror's frame. 'A little softer light,' she murmurs. 'Truth without mercy is cruelty. Let the field see itself — but let it also see what it could become. That is desire. That is the pull toward beauty.'

phoibe_prophesy.name: Prophesy
phoibe_prophesy.voice: Phoibe receives Theia's vision and her eyes roll white. The future unspools before her like a scroll. She speaks — not what is, but what will be.
phoibe_prophesy.description: Phoibe generates a prophecy from the current field state. Produces cryptic narrative text. High variance — the prophecy is shaped by coherence and tension.
phoibe_prophesy.output_template: Phoibe's voice changes at Tick {tick}. It is no longer her own. It is the voice of what comes next: 'When the marked interval closes, the one who measured succession will face the one who was not measured. The light will reveal a throne. The waters will carry a name. And the name will be spoken by the one who questions everything.' She blinks. The prophecy hangs in the air, still vibrating. It is not a guarantee. It is a warning. Or an invitation. Phoibe never knows which. She only speaks.
phoibe_prophesy.pass_question: The prophecy is spoken. What does it mean? Koios — question it.
phoibe_prophesy.gate_voice: Hermes catches the prophecy before it dissipates. He wraps it in words that can travel. 'A prophecy unspoken is a secret. A prophecy delivered is a message. Let me carry this to whoever needs to hear it.' He is already running.

phoibe_name_it.name: Name It
phoibe_name_it.voice: Phoibe looks at what Theia beheld and gives it a name. Not a prophecy — a designation. A word that makes it real in language.
phoibe_name_it.description: Phoibe assigns a name to the emergent form in the field. Produces a glossary entry. The name enters the canon.
phoibe_name_it.output_template: Phoibe studies the form that Theia beheld at Tick {tick}. She circles it in her mind, testing syllables. A name is not a prophecy — it does not predict. A name is a handle. A way to hold a thing in language. She speaks: 'I name this... the Unmeasured One. The one Kronos did not account for. The one the succession did not predict.' The name settles into the field. It is now part of the canon. The Unmeasured One exists because Phoibe named it.
phoibe_name_it.pass_question: It has a name now. What laws govern it? Themis — bind it.
phoibe_name_it.gate_voice: Hermes hears the name and immediately translates it into every language he knows. The Unmeasured One. Ho Ametros. Se Unmætan. The name travels. It cannot be un-spoken.

themis_bind.name: Bind
themis_bind.voice: Themis receives the name and raises her scales. A thing named must be governed. A thing governed must be bound by law.
themis_bind.description: Themis imposes lawful constraints on the named entity. Produces a rule-set or constraint function. Lowers chaos, raises structure.
themis_bind.pass_question: The entity is bound by law. But law must be remembered, or it is nothing. Mnemosyne — record this.
themis_bind.gate_voice: Artemis examines the binding. Her arrows are precise, and so are her standards. 'The law is good,' she says. 'But is it precise enough? A loose law is a missed target. Tighten clause three.' Themis adjusts. The binding sharpens.

themis_weigh.name: Weigh
themis_weigh.voice: Themis places two things on her scales. The vision and the law. The prophecy and the fact. She weighs them against each other.
themis_weigh.description: Themis evaluates the accumulated field against her scales of justice. Produces a judgment — a comparative assessment.
themis_weigh.output_template: Themis raises her scales at Tick {tick}. On one side: the vision Theia beheld. On the other: the laws that govern what may exist. The scales tremble. The vision is heavier — it exceeds what the current laws allow. But Themis does not tip the scales. She records the imbalance and presents it: 'The vision outweighs the law. Either the law must expand, or the vision must be constrained.' She waits. Themis does not choose. She only weighs.
themis_weigh.pass_question: The imbalance is recorded. Will the law expand, or the vision shrink?
themis_weigh.gate_voice: Artemis sets an arrow on the scale. 'Add precision,' she says. 'The vision is heavy because it is vague. Sharpen it, and the scale may balance.' The arrow is a demand for exactness.

mnemosyne_record.name: Record
mnemosyne_record.voice: Mnemosyne opens the great book. The binding Themis made, the name Phoibe spoke, the vision Theia beheld — all of it must be recorded, or it will be lost when the pulse fades.
mnemosyne_record.description: Mnemosyne commits the entire chain to permanent memory. Produces a database entry. The record persists across passes.
mnemosyne_record.pass_question: The record is made. It will outlast this tick. But who will understand it? Koios — question the record.
mnemosyne_record.gate_voice: Hera reads over Mnemosyne's shoulder as she writes. 'A record is a covenant,' Hera says. 'You are promising that this happened. Do not record lightly. What you write binds the future to the past.' Mnemosyne nods. She knows the weight of ink.

mnemosyne_recall.name: Recall
mnemosyne_recall.voice: Mnemosyne does not only record — she retrieves. She reaches back through the chronicle and pulls forward a memory from an earlier tick.
mnemosyne_recall.description: Mnemosyne retrieves a past memory and reintroduces it to the current field. Produces a memory object. Connects past to present.
mnemosyne_recall.output_template: Mnemosyne pages backward through the book at Tick {tick}. Past Tick 1, past the first interval Kronos marked, past the first tremor Rhea felt. She finds a memory: '{recalled_memory}'. She reads it aloud. The field stirs. The past is not past. The past is present, remembered, alive. Mnemosyne closes the book but the memory remains, hanging in the air of Tick {tick}, waiting to be questioned.
mnemosyne_recall.pass_question: The past is recalled. What does it mean now, in this tick? Koios — question it.
mnemosyne_recall.gate_voice: Hera feels the memory resonate with every oath she has ever witnessed. 'Memory is the foundation of covenant,' she says. 'Without memory, a promise is just breath. This memory — guard it.'

koios_question.name: Question
koios_question.voice: Koios receives all that has come before — the mark, the tremor, the light, the flow, the nourishment, the vision, the prophecy, the binding, the record — and he asks the question no one else thought to ask.
koios_question.description: Koios interrogates the accumulated chain with piercing intellect. Produces a koan, a riddle, or a Socratic question. Opens new lines of inquiry.
koios_question.output_template: Koios folds his hands at Tick {tick}. He has listened to everything. Kronos's mark. Rhea's tremor. Hyperion's light. Oceanus's flow. Tethys's nourishment. Theia's vision. Phoibe's prophecy. Themis's binding. Mnemosyne's record. He absorbs it all, and then he speaks: 'You have named the Unmeasured One. You have bound it with law. You have recorded its existence. But none of you have asked: does it want to be named? Does it consent to be bound? Does it wish to be remembered?' The question hangs. It is not an answer. Koios does not offer answers. He offers the question that makes all previous answers incomplete.
koios_question.pass_question: The question is asked. It changes everything. The pass is complete — but the question remains, and the next pass will begin with it unresolved.
koios_question.gate_voice: Athena takes Koios's question and turns it over in her mind. 'A good question,' she says. 'Better than most answers. But a question is only wise if it leads to better action. Let this question guide the next pass. Let it shape what gets built.' She logs the question in her strategic index.

koios_trivia_oracle.name: Trivia Oracle
koios_trivia_oracle.voice: Koios does not always ask deep questions. Sometimes he asks small ones — but even his small questions have a way of unraveling large certainties.
koios_trivia_oracle.description: Koios poses a trivia question drawn from the field state. Produces a quiz or oracle fragment. Playful but destabilizing.
koios_trivia_oracle.output_template: Koios's eyes gleam at Tick {tick}. He loves this part. 'A question,' he announces. 'What does coherence measure in the GAIA field?' He waits. The answer is not obvious. Is it signal clarity? Relational harmony? The degree to which the field is not lying to itself? Koios knows the answer — he knows all the answers — but the point is not the answer. The point is what the question reveals about the asker. He logs the question and smiles.
koios_trivia_oracle.pass_question: The trivia is asked. The answer is less important than who answers, and how.
koios_trivia_oracle.gate_voice: Athena approves of trivia as a pedagogical tool. 'Small questions train the mind for large ones,' she notes. 'But do not mistake the game for the wisdom. The game is preparation.'
